title: Which Demographic Features Are Relevant for Individual Fairness Evaluation of U.S. Recidivism Risk Assessment Tools?
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness, a branch of AI ethics. It specifically evaluates and analyzes human moral and ethical judgments regarding what constitutes 'fair' versus 'unfair' treatment in recidivism risk assessments, using these ethical perceptions to propose improvements to algorithmic similarity functions.
